title: Camera-fit derivation exists in three inline copies; the camera_fit comment's 'ONE source' claim overstates
detail: The load-bearing fit formula is copy-pasted at three sites. camera_update sits in the same package as camera_fit and could call it; a future fit-rule change (e.g. board margins) risks silent divergence, and the comment misleads readers.
recommended_fix: Have camera_update call camera_fit(v) instead of inlining; keep view_compute's copy (different package) but soften or drop the 'ONE source' comment.

title: App.auto_pullback mirrors App.a11y.auto_pullback — two sources of truth synced by hand
evidence:
app/main.odin:236 (App struct):
	auto_pullback: bool,
	pullback:      bool,

app/main.odin:344 (main init):
	app.auto_pullback = app.a11y.auto_pullback

app/main.odin:1025-1026 (effect_settings_adjust):
		app.a11y.auto_pullback = !app.a11y.auto_pullback
		app.auto_pullback = app.a11y.auto_pullback
detail: The same toggle lives on App twice (a11y struct + mirror field), kept in sync at two write sites. A future writer updating one copy silently diverges feed behavior from the persisted setting and panel display.
recommended_fix: Delete App.auto_pullback; read app.a11y.auto_pullback directly in pullback_feed, draw_hud's snapshot, and the toggle effect.
